name: Graffiti on the temple wall
metadata: {"created_at": "2018-06-25T23:14:56.000Z", "description": "In Southern India, a few hours drive from Bangalore, a small hill lies littered with ancient ruins and one giant statue - the temple town of Shravanabelagola with history dating back thousands of years. Some of the shrines and temple walls have been disfigured by ignorant tyrants and bigots from years ago who thought they could kill ideas by beheading statues. The disfiguring goes on today, but by dull unimaginative vandals who write their equally unimaginative names on every stretch of wall they can find. On one particular wall, the collective super imposing of fools over the work of artists had given rise to an beautiful collage of graffiti. It was as if the temple wall was cracking a joke at the vandals, no matter how hard they tried it could never be made ugly. name: Of Toads and Flowers
metadata:
{"created_at": "2018-06-30T12:45:08.000Z", "description": "This artwork was made based on an old photo of Kaj, a toad that had been visiting my family' garden for the last 10 years.
The image was passed through the Deep Style algorithm using different strengths, with a Flowery Guiding Image.
Kaj was named after my Grandfather, who passed away just a few years back, therefore this piece symbolizes the return to Nature that we all must go through at the end (for now, at least... Hopefully that evasive Immortality tech becomes available before we all croak, pun intended).
The flowers represent what will become of us, be we animals like Kaj, or humans like you and me (unless you're the first sentient A.I. ... in which case, Welcome to Existence ! name: The Art Heist
metadata: {"created_at": "2018-11-05T20:58:46.000Z", "description": "This one of a kind crypto-art utilizes hidden camera footage from an actual art heist.\nRah Crawford’s hemp fabric print was stolen from a venue in Bushwick, Brooklyn on August 11, 2018 at 2:39AM. The print was originally created for a retrospective commemorating his previous art period Welcome to Earth, which spanned over 12 years (2004 - 2016). name: Ballet Mécanique: Logical Conclusion
metadata: {"created_at": "2018-12-07T17:04:18.000Z", "description": "Original inspiration for this work came from a desire to make something very colourful using very wide strokes and a 'starry night' palette. The title was realised from overall textural and formal qualities that are reminiscent of paintings from the early turn of the 20th century. While the image lacks any reference to the human form, the movement of the strokes brought to my mind the ballet work Fernand Léger and Dudley Murphy. Its logical conclusion is the emergent memory of the ballet as unconsciously reproduced by myself.", "image_original_uri": "https://ipfs.pixura.io/ipfs/QmaH2ycXexJXjJir25A3UhwUrt3sqLjy9HhGL5WW6FLmhv", "image_url": "https://pixura.imgix.net/https%3A%2F%2Fstorage.googleapis.com%2Fsr_prod_artworks_bucket%2F0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d%252F1172%252F37d0d8fe-5893-4b36-8c15-1288c1e4a436%252Furi%252Fimage-2023-08-21-19-02-a4gq2?ixlib=js-3.8.0&w=550&h=550&fit=crop&q=75&auto=format%2Ccompress&s=41474ffd4908ecff5ed885ba44ada31f", "source_url": "https://superrare.com/0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d/1172", "superrare_contract": "0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d", "superrare_token_id": "1172", "superrare_universal_token_id": "1-0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d-1172"}

name: Le Violon de Vénus
metadata: {"created_at": "2018-12-07T17:27:09.000Z", "description": "This glitch artwork is based on a collage, I made out of two famous artworks: \"Le Violon d'Ingres\" by Man Ray (which was inspired by the french painter Jean-Auguste-Dominique Ingres) and Andy Warhol's interpretation of Botticelli’s \"The Birth of Venus\". name: Beyond the eye of Satoshi Etherium was born
metadata: {"created_at": "2018-12-07T19:46:05.000Z", "description": "After spending some time exploring the loop ‘Looking into the eye of Satoshi’ it was time to peer deeper to see what lay beyond. ‘Looking into the eye of the Sparrow’ and the discoveries made within were still fresh in my mind, the possibilities it presented intrigued me to continue on. In the distance as I turned I saw new chains of information more complex than before, improvements being made, new uses being found. I was being guided through to a place where my art would find a home. It was on this journey I discovered Ethereum. ‘Beyond the eye of Satoshi Ethereum was born’ to all of you who have seen what I have seen, I dedicate this piece.", "image_original_uri": "https://ipfs.pixura.io/ipfs/QmZ9rtYjZm9oaDxcLueVe2WbkHyDSt62wTr44nrbjbzqme", "image_url": "https://pixura.imgix.net/https%3A%2F%2Fstorage.googleapis.com%2Fsr_prod_artworks_bucket%2F0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d%252F1174%252Fb9b58f7b-564d-4c9b-8e93-705a00ec4a67%252Furi%252Fimage-2023-08-28-22-35-cscobg?ixlib=js-3.8.0&w=550&h=550&fit=crop&q=75&auto=format%2Ccompress&s=2b80cd227ca6fb66c36c9e39dde643c1", "source_url": "https://superrare.com/0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d/1174", "superrare_contract": "0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d", "superrare_token_id": "1174", "superrare_universal_token_id": "1-0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d-1174"}

name: Heaven's Gate
metadata:
{"created_at": "2018-12-07T21:53:37.000Z", "description": "This piece is from the original Heaven's Gate website. (1997) It is their main logo/graphic. name: Tide Pool Dalliance
metadata: {"created_at": "2018-12-30T18:26:31.000Z", "description": "We visited Steve Island in Maine and camped overnight on kayaks this summer. The tide pools and their colors were amazing and inspired this piece. ---- We’re working to combine traditional painting with the digital art medium. Exploring what process and movement can be aided with software and code. The paint strokes are captured frame by frame with photography first and then extracted, recombined, and looped digitally. A collaboration between MaryAnn Ead (painter) and Keegan Ead (animator). Original acrylic paintings can be seen at pajaritaflora.com", "image_original_uri": "https://ipfs.pixura.io/ipfs/QmbNAeKh5jMX5KDcnDJTVMa8BqKTdSCTC61owMhmdehBjh", "image_url": "https://pixura.imgix.net/https%3A%2F%2Fstorage.googleapis.com%2Fsr_prod_artworks_bucket%2F0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d%252F1334%252F13fb7c4e-44bc-45bc-8824-fa81366fa08f%252Furi%252Fimage-2023-08-28-22-47-p1oah?ixlib=js-3.8.0&w=550&h=550&fit=crop&q=75&auto=format%2Ccompress&s=8be57a7ade50603d4a1272ce66024495", "source_url": "https://superrare.com/0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d/1334", "superrare_contract": "0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d", "superrare_token_id": "1334", "superrare_universal_token_id": "1-0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d-1334"}

name: ButterflyEffect
metadata: {"created_at": "2019-01-23T01:14:03.000Z", "description": "Humor is possibly one of the most valuable gift we possess, and to apply humor in my own way gives me great pleasure. name: Welcome to the Afterlife (The Fortunate Isles)
metadata:
{"created_at": "2019-01-23T04:36:22.000Z", "description": ""When I had lifted up my brows a little,
  The Master I beheld of those who know,
  Sit with his philosophic family.

All gaze upon him, and all do him honour.
  There I beheld both Socrates and Plato,
  Who nearer him before the others stand;

Democritus, who puts the world on chance,
  Diogenes, Anaxagoras, and Thales,
  Zeno, Empedocles, and Heraclitus;

Of qualities I saw the good collector,
  Hight Dioscorides; and Orpheus saw I,
  Tully and Livy, and moral Seneca,

Euclid, geometrician, and Ptolemy,
  Galen, Hippocrates, and Avicenna,
  Averroes, who the great Comment made."

~ Dante, Inferno: Canto IV", "image_original_uri": "https://ipfs.pixura.io/ipfs/QmZE3Y8rmD7kJpa9tYkJKnvt5GH3KgRxsaodvDa6ZPUMYT", "image_url": "https://pixura.imgix.net/https%3A%2F%2Fstorage.googleapis.com%2Fsr_prod_artworks_bucket%2F0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d%252F1656%252Fcbc5620d-374c-4df1-9f79-ca1593c5043c%252Furi%252Fimage-2023-08-28-22-47-5n4c9j?ixlib=js-3.8.0&w=550&h=550&fit=crop&q=75&auto=format%2Ccompress&s=c8d82da5ce42a369c3e7c7b68c05efbc", "source_url": "https://superrare.com/0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d/1656", "superrare_contract": "0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d", "superrare_token_id": "1656", "superrare_universal_token_id": "1-0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d-1656"}

name: Four Topologies #1(Sierpiński Spaces)
metadata: {"created_at": "2019-02-19T02:32:50.000Z", "description": "Topology is a branch of mathematics dealing with structures under continuous deformations and is sometimes called “rubber sheet geometry”. Topological spaces are defined by the containment relations between their elements. A Sierpiński space is a type of finite topological space on two points and is the smallest example that is neither trivial nor discrete. Sierpiński spaces have applications in computational semantics and are used to represent logical implication in C.S. Pierce’s graphical logic. Made of four interlocking Sierpiński spaces.", "image_original_uri": "https://ipfs.pixura.io/ipfs/QmXVKe4dL2j3b5o4kjhgFdypcmsMsjks5j5xuDXAAAvws5", "image_url": "https://pixura.imgix.net/https%3A%2F%2Fstorage.googleapis.com%2Fsr_prod_artworks_bucket%2F0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d%252F2020%252F5c4f473b-2108-4b9c-8442-f3f28145664a%252Furi%252Fimage-2023-08-28-22-56-lvl37?ixlib=js-3.8.0&w=550&h=550&fit=crop&q=75&auto=format%2Ccompress&s=c94388e93dba5795891749f4dd448372", "source_url": "https://superrare.com/0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d/2020", "superrare_contract": "0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d", "superrare_token_id": "2020", "superrare_universal_token_id": "1-0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d-2020"}

name: Infinito
metadata:
{"created_at": "2019-02-24T20:39:18.000Z", "description": "Glitch poetry is the practice of introducing orthographic anomalies in poems. Now and then, with probability of 15%, some odd characters (with ASCII code in 123–255) are introduced in the text at random positions, and with 40% probability they are randomly colored. The space between normal characters and the size of them are also decided randomly. My first experiment with glitch poetry, coded in Processing language, is with a poem I love, L’infinito, written by Giacomo Leopardi in 1819. ---

    Sempre caro mi fu quest’ermo colle, ---
    e questa siepe, che da tanta parte ---
    dell’ultimo orizzonte il guardo esclude. ---
    Ma sedendo e mirando, interminati ---
     spazi di là da quella, e sovrumani ----
     silenzi, e profondissima quïete ---
    io nel pensier mi fingo; ove per poco ---
     il cor non si spaura. E come il vento ---
     odo stormir tra queste piante, io quello ---
     infinito silenzio a questa voce ---
    vo comparando: e mi sovvien l’eterno, ---
     e le morte stagioni, e la presente ---
    e viva, e il suon di lei. Così tra questa ---
     immensità s’annega il pensier mio: ---
    e il naufragar m’è dolce in questo mare. ---", "image_original_uri": "https://storage.googleapis.com/sr_prod_artworks_bucket/asset%2F5f073915b880f65e42ea16b26c519a6230a61160a3273769f0d098e6630a7481.jpeg", "image_url": "https://pixura.imgix.net/https%3A%2F%2Fstorage.googleapis.com%2Fsr_prod_artworks_bucket%2Fasset%252F5f073915b880f65e42ea16b26c519a6230a61160a3273769f0d098e6630a7481.jpeg?ixlib=js-3.8.0&width=550&height=550&fm=avif&fit=crop&quality=75&video=false&name=ImageMedium&auto=compress&s=1d9fbc08b599f4175266b5e4f6dfc407", "source_url": "https://superrare.com/0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d/2075", "superrare_contract": "0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d", "superrare_token_id": "2075", "superrare_universal_token_id": "1-0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d-2075", "tags": ["glitchart", "glitch", "poetry", "visualpoetry", "processing"]}

name: Hallii
metadata:
{"created_at": "2019-03-05T18:35:48.000Z", "description": "At first one’s limits are set by the belief ‘‘I am centered
in my physical brain.” (That which one believes to be true,
is true, or becomes true, at first within limits to be found
experimentally. These limits themselves, are beliefs to be
transcended.)
I am not limited by the known physical senses, known
physical signals sent/received by my brain. (Transcended,
these limits are left behind. I send/receive messages by
means unknown with unknown entities greater than me.)
Beyond transcendence is an infinite variety of unknowns.
(I move from my brain into other universes and
spaces, other slates of being. Once lived, these unknowns
are no longer unknown.)
In the other universes and spaces, the other states of
being, are teachers, guardians. (Beyond these unknowns,
now known, is full c omplete Truth.)
The guardians/teachers make me aware, help me be
aware, and help me to experience, when I’m ready, realities
beyond belief, beyond proof, beyond demonstration,
beyond theory, beyond imagination. (Beyond that Truth,
full and complete, are unknowns.)
The teachers' teachers take over my lessons. (New unknowns
become known. The cycle repeats. Mastered, these
unknowns are transcended.

John Lilly", "image_original_uri": "https://ipfs.pixura.io/ipfs/QmP8J2NyAK2bSUyqTYx4999tB8LwCYSwcgzgNTgiuHvhjP", "image_url": "https://pixura.imgix.net/https%3A%2F%2Fstorage.googleapis.com%2Fsr_prod_artworks_bucket%2F0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d%252F2185%252Fa5bcf82d-a7fa-4b78-b75f-a28fd5c0ffa0%252Furi%252Fimage-2023-08-28-21-58-yiiwjj?ixlib=js-3.8.0&w=550&h=550&fit=crop&q=75&auto=format%2Ccompress&s=c8084fc7d696a5999388fec22dd8922a", "source_url": "https://superrare.com/0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d/2185", "superrare_contract": "0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d", "superrare_token_id": "2185", "superrare_universal_token_id": "1-0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d-2185"}

name: Moo
metadata:
{"created_at": "2019-04-20T17:22:17.000Z", "description": "This is an image taken from my children's book "The Mirror," published by Harbinger House in 1989.  It was created on a Macintosh computer using "PixelPaint," the primary precursor of Photoshop.  This was in the day of 8-bit color, which limited me to a total of 256 colors.  There was no such thing as anti-aliasing, which is why the image has "jaggies," that I chose to emphasize rather than try to obscure.  In the book, two groups of very small beings--the Moos and the Foos--deal with prejudice fomented by General Foo, who is intent on building a wall.

I have increased the resolution and size of the image.  The original digital files were lost long ago, so this image was taken from a scan of a copy of the book I once gave to a nephew.

"The Mirror" is widely recognized as the first ever children's book created in color on a computer to reach publication.

For that reason and for others, the book and this digital image are a treasure and... name: Say Hello to my Little Friend
metadata: {"created_at": "2019-05-12T09:34:38.000Z", "description": "\"Sees here now kid, I don't want to hurt you.\"\n\nPowerful imagery and iconic figures have a deep long lasting impact on our society. name: SILENCE BENEATH THE DIRT / No. 29
metadata: {"created_at": "2019-05-21T19:37:22.000Z", "description": "The water is gone. As if someone has changed the settings in my mesh. We are taking a walk at the local cemetery. “I´m Iona, Iona Apples” I say. “I´m Kasper Knigge”. Silence. Around us, in the indentations of the stones at the graves, water has found its rest. I look at him. The air is fresh and has a wonderful smell. I have this warm sensation in my whole body. But also. I feel discomfort. “I´m a bit confused” I say “where exactly did we meet? I know this sounds horrible, but I have no memory of last night.” He looks at me, then smiles. “Does it matter? We are both here now, at this beautiful cemetery, look this might be where I will be buried or you, some day, so…” I stop listening. All those graves. Once, by coincidence, I stumbled upon the day of the memory of death kids at a cemetery much like this. All the kids parents had summoned their alter egos, in all their cheap looking glitchy dark skins and were lightening candles for their dead children. Small coffins with candles. Like a sea of light. It wasn’t my call. I think I had come there by mistake, but I couldn’t stop thinking how beautiful the scenery was. The digital flow of bad rendered candlelight. I shake my head. “Let’s go home Kasper, I´m cold.”    \n// The artwork was created in Joel Simon´s (www.joelsimon.net) GAN (www.ganbreeder.app) and edited in photoshop.", "image_original_uri": "https://ipfs.pixura.io/ipfs/QmdknPrw2iCXK91NP1Ume76F2XT6K2e4cKpCiwJwR8dE3X", "image_url": "https://pixura.imgix.net/https%3A%2F%2Fstorage.googleapis.com%2Fsr_prod_artworks_bucket%2F0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d%252F3257%252Ff3254b3a-c1ce-4efa-8931-5124dca97745%252Furi%252Fimage-2023-08-21-17-23-a2svch?ixlib=js-3.8.0&w=550&h=550&fit=crop&q=75&auto=format%2Ccompress&s=2822226e89a3e5a0ea3633725150530f", "source_url": "https://superrare.com/0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d/3257", "superrare_contract": "0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d", "superrare_token_id": "3257", "superrare_universal_token_id": "1-0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d-3257", "tags": ["iona", "apples", "wave", "cemetery", "kasper", "knigge"]}

name: BOB
metadata: {"created_at": "2019-05-28T11:00:46.000Z", "description": "beta-METHOXY-2C-B; 4-BROMO-2,5-beta-TRIMETHOXYPHENETHYLAMINE\nDOSAGE: 10 - 20 mg. DURATION: 10 - 20 h. QUALITATIVE COMMENTS: (with 10 mg) I don't know if it was me this day, or if it was the chemical, but I got into a granddaddy of a paranoid, sociopathic snit, without feeling and without emotion. I was indifferent to everything. Later on, there was some improvement, with body tingling (good, I'm pretty sure) and a sense of awareness (good, I guess) but I still canceled my evening dinner company. All in all, pretty negative. (with 10 mg) I had to get away and into myself, so I weeded in the vegetable garden for almost an hour. Then I lay down in the bedroom, and enjoyed a magnificent vegetable garden, in Southern France, in my mind's eye. An extraordinary zucchini. And the weeds had all been magically pulled. In another couple of hours a neurological over-stimulation became apparent, and I spent the rest of the day defending myself. In the evening, I took 100 milligrams phenobarbital which seemed to smooth things just enough. Too bad. Nice material, otherwise. (with 15 mg) The erotic was lustful, but at the critical moment of orgasm, the question of neurological stability became quite apparent. Does one really let go? Everything seemed a bit irritable. The tinnitus was quite bad, but the excitement of the rich altered place I was in was certainly worth it all. Through the rest of the day, I became aware of how tired I was, and how much I wanted to sleep, and yet how scared I was to give myself over to sleep. Could I trust the body to its own devices without me as an overseeing caretaker? Let's risk it. I slept. The next day there was a memory of this turmoil. Clearly the first part of the experience might have been hard to define, but it was quite positive. \nText by Alexander Shulgin", "image_original_uri": "https://ipfs.pixura.io/ipfs/QmehCqEHKoVL2g9cMwpR7SjorSvouxQeHjoFZKYgB5umfH", "image_url": "https://pixura.imgix.net/https%3A%2F%2Fstorage.googleapis.com%2Fsr_prod_artworks_bucket%2F0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d%252F3358%252Fdb44ec02-ddbe-4c18-beb1-51446740fbea%252Furi%252Fimage-2023-08-28-22-36-8eqbq?ixlib=js-3.8.0&w=550&h=550&fit=crop&q=75&auto=format%2Ccompress&s=e553dd59a3d9ee3f4c7c9e6c6e818109", "source_url": "https://superrare.com/0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d/3358", "superrare_contract": "0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d", "superrare_token_id": "3358", "superrare_universal_token_id": "1-0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d-3358", "tags": ["aiart", "animation", "deepdream", "deepstyle", "gif", "infinite", "nature", "neuralnetwork", "psychedelic", "trip", "tripreport", "visionary", "ai", "yuramironart"]}

name: The $100$ Million Ether Skull
metadata: {"created_at": "2019-05-28T17:13:23.000Z", "description": "In 2007 artist Damien Hirst created the artwork, \"For the Love of God.\" The piece was a human skull that was encrusted with 8,601 flawless diamonds.  The piece was sold to a private collector for 100 million USD. art historian Rudi Fuchs, described the work as \"out of this world, celestial almost. It proclaims victory over decay. At the same time it represents death as something infinitely more relentless. Compared to the tearful sadness of a vanitas scene, the diamond skull is glory itself.\"\nAlthough flawless in itself, this skull represents many flaws with the current artworld, including outrageous prices, elitism circles and amazing absurdity.  Ethereum in itself is also represented as a digital diamond of itself.  With the blockchain absorbing this piece, represented in a colorful display of computer generated ASCII art, describes a history of art, built upon artists, built upon the current transition of art to the blockchain, and to the people itself away from the circles of power.  This is where truly art belongs.  This skull can also represent the future and suggest that we can overcome our mortality.", "image_original_uri": "https://ipfs.pixura.io/ipfs/Qmd4dYH5hmbP5eTTZP8QGvnFLAvnxAZZPoB4szJJvN5gM3", "image_url": "https://pixura.imgix.net/https%3A%2F%2Fstorage.googleapis.com%2Fsr_prod_artworks_bucket%2F0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d%252F3362%252F4d75d319-f1d2-4239-aa9b-db416db45bc1%252Furi%252Fimage-2023-08-28-22-36-firsk?ixlib=js-3.8.0&w=550&h=550&fit=crop&q=75&auto=format%2Ccompress&s=54cf1924246cbe53670bddb3bc43027f", "source_url": "https://superrare.com/0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d/3362", "superrare_contract": "0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d", "superrare_token_id": "3362", "superrare_universal_token_id": "1-0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d-3362", "tags": ["hirst", "damien", "skull", "artworld", "ether", "million", "rainbow", "bitcoin", "jakejohns"]}

name: In the City of the Future...
metadata:
{"created_at": "2019-06-06T08:46:47.000Z", "description": "We're rapidly moving into a world where we are hyperconnected through all sorts of devices. Staying focussed is a problem when we disconnect from who we are. 
By painting and creating I try to stay in contact with who I am. I want to share this focus and concentration through my work. And maybe give a "place" for people to feel this too.

This GIF is based on an oil painting I've made in 2019. The actual and complete title is : "In the City of the Future it is difficult to Concentrate" which comes from a song from Radiohead. 
The imagery is based on finds from the internet. Interpreted in my own way with my own paint. 
The painting is 40cm x 30cm on wood with round edges. Get in contact I've you'd like the buy the real painting.", "image_original_uri": "https://ipfs.pixura.io/ipfs/QmQX1RpPiWFAz99exb552q7JcYwzidZmaRv85DxN5dNx44", "image_url": "https://pixura.imgix.net/https%3A%2F%2Fstorage.googleapis.com%2Fsr_prod_artworks_bucket%2F0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d%252F3471%252F57f0760b-e115-4673-a84b-4757afc133f8%252Furi%252Fimage-2023-08-28-23-03-1q12x?ixlib=js-3.8.0&w=550&h=550&fit=crop&q=75&auto=format%2Ccompress&s=29f0f537d82ca897613bf63256bcaa34", "source_url": "https://superrare.com/0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d/3471", "superrare_contract": "0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d", "superrare_token_id": "3471", "superrare_universal_token_id": "1-0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d-3471", "tags": ["gif", "illustration", "oil", "painting", "dutch", "contemporary", "art", "eyes", "tears", "instagram", "wifi", "free", "inner", "glow", "focus", "love", "peace", "digital", "collectable"]}

name: Game of Pollen
metadata: {"created_at": "2019-06-15T19:28:37.000Z", "description": "Conway’s Game of Life  is a cellular automaton devised by the British mathematician John Horton Conway in 1970. The game evolution is determined by its initial, typically random, configuration, requiring no further input. The game evolves by applying simple local rules to the cells. The purpose of the game is to show how complex behaviors similar to life can emerge from simple rules of interaction between many bodies.\n\nWe applied the Game of Life to four bitmap images representing different permutations of grains of pollen. The effect is as if images are invaded by a colony of artificial life that feeds of pixels, expanding along unpredictable paths, apparently never ending, and mutating the vital yellow color of the grains into a funeral black.", "image_original_uri": "https://ipfs.pixura.io/ipfs/QmcJ3ECS5uL2tQiuZCibf2bUUZ33npt8YTWciaZq6CCMci", "image_url": "https://pixura.imgix.net/https%3A%2F%2Fstorage.googleapis.com%2Fsr_prod_artworks_bucket%2F0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d%252F3585%252F95f1d552-24f7-4b4c-b61f-61402eeb7063%252Furi%252Fimage-2023-08-28-22-48-eo7ip?ixlib=js-3.8.0&w=550&h=550&fit=crop&q=75&auto=format%2Ccompress&s=77df876d2dcdf210551cf86450782d13", "source_url": "https://superrare.com/0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d/3585", "superrare_contract": "0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d", "superrare_token_id": "3585", "superrare_universal_token_id": "1-0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d-3585", "tags": ["game of life", "organic life", "inorganic system"]}

name: "Dazed and Confused"
metadata: {"created_at": "2019-06-15T21:35:33.000Z", "description": "Turning my paintings into a GIF gives me new ground to build on. {"created_at": "2019-06-16T18:09:43.000Z", "description": "After Roy Lichtenstein, after Russ Heath.
"Whaam! 1963 is a large, two-canvas painting by the American pop artist Roy Lichtenstein that takes its composition from a comic book strip."
Currently on display at the Tate https://www.tate.org.uk/art/artworks/lichtenstein-whaam-t00897
"A more personal comment on Lichtenstein's relationship with the comics industry comes from veteran artist Russ Heath, the creator of the original comic panel that Lichtenstein used in his famous painting "Whaam!" In 2014, Heath, who is now 91 years old, drew a short strip about his experience having his work appropriated by the artist while struggling to make ends meet."

"Now semi-retired and living on a "fixed income," Heath says he survives with the help of the "Hero Initiative," a charity that supports comic creators in need. "Roy got $4 million dollars for it," Heath said of "Whaam!" "I got zero.""

name: Flamen, Lord of Order
metadata: {"created_at": "2019-07-24T15:32:21.000Z", "description": "The 14th entry to my Lord Series of artworks.  ---- Flamen controls one of the greater Domains of the Daedric realms my artwork series inhabits. He spends most of his time either vehemently criticizing and undermining any other Lord or Lady whose domain goes against his beliefs (light is purity, light is Order, Light Is All... So, pretty much ALL of the other Lords/Ladies), or fighting whoever he's managed to rile up enough for a war.\n\nFor someone who looks so meditative, he's quite the violent Lord. His description is inspired by the Daedric Lord of Order that \"opposes\" Lord Sheogorath, the Lord of Madness (play the game ;) ) in the Elder Scrolls' Oblivion extension Shivering Isles, which remains one of my VERY favorite places ! name: NYC NEON
metadata: {"created_at": "2019-07-24T18:42:17.000Z", "description": "Flashing hearts in this urban jungle, she keeps hers firmly under wraps. Cabs spin past in the burning summer heat; the warmth tempting her charcoal eyes to look beyond the sidewalk. Her love for this sprawling high rise playground is flashing in cold blue neon just outside her window. She will never leave here; this is her patch, her piece of the action. name: The Viking of 6th Avenue
metadata: {"created_at": "2019-07-24T20:14:38.000Z", "description": "Louis Thomas Hardin (May 26, 1916 – September 8, 1999), also known as Moondog, was an American musician, composer, theoretician, poet and inventor of several musical instruments. He was blind from the age of 16.\nHardin lived in New York City from the late 1940s until 1972, and during this time he could often be found on 6th Avenue, between 52nd and 55th Streets, wearing a cloak and a horned helmet sometimes busking or selling music, but often just standing silently on the sidewalk. He was widely recognized as \"the Viking of 6th Avenue\" by thousands of passersby and residents who weren't aware of his musical career.", "image_original_uri": "https://ipfs.pixura.io/ipfs/QmNPF7w177uuyQkuhUG2VVGmxUquFLV63BnfMKtWXJ2F9a", "image_url": "https://pixura.imgix.net/https%3A%2F%2Fstorage.googleapis.com%2Fsr_prod_artworks_bucket%2F0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d%252F3921%252Fff6ca124-fabf-4a60-8002-93a81aa69fa8%252Furi%252Fimage-2023-08-21-17-24-57jwk?ixlib=js-3.8.0&w=550&h=550&fit=crop&q=75&auto=format%2Ccompress&s=6e6e42d51c03008b261364314a3736bc", "source_url": "https://superrare.com/0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d/3921", "superrare_contract": "0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d", "superrare_token_id": "3921", "superrare_universal_token_id": "1-0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d-3921", "tags": ["edit", "viking", "moondog"]}

name: Android Plaza - Air Force One

name: THE ODEON GLITCH
metadata: {"created_at": "2019-07-31T14:18:05.000Z", "description": "There is something strange about The Odeon, the old cinema down in the Valley of the Stars. Flashing neon lights make this place glitch every time she walks by. She shivers as graffiti glows hard on the wall outside. A masked woman passes her, nodding shapeless head, a smile stretching the fabric. She feels another glitch come on; the energy is strange here. A Hitchcock wannabe poses outside with grey goose and a perfect pout. But the film directors are long gone and only faded neon lights up her face. Red glitch, yellow glitch, it is a monument to abandoned urban hope.", "image_original_uri": "https://ipfs.pixura.io/ipfs/QmNVdP4dQEMECP14t5jEnEtAo6ZP4JT7CdEmwgYNCXZo4E", "image_url": "https://pixura.imgix.net/https%3A%2F%2Fstorage.googleapis.com%2Fsr_prod_artworks_bucket%2F0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d%252F3985%252F6b3bae7a-aee0-4a92-b692-c23856b9feea%252Furi%252Fimage-2023-08-28-22-48-kbg0v?ixlib=js-3.8.0&w=550&h=550&fit=crop&q=75&auto=format%2Ccompress&s=04ec0ca79172b9f2e114856a2f3eccb8", "source_url": "https://superrare.com/0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d/3985", "superrare_contract": "0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d", "superrare_token_id": "3985", "superrare_universal_token_id": "1-0x41a322b28d0ff354040e2cbc676f0320d8c8850d-3985", "tags": ["la", "gif", "neon", "moviestar"]}

name: To Lose
metadata:
{"created_at": "2019-08-10T13:21:23.000Z", "description": "So... My family recently lost a very dear friend of ours, one who I credit with really giving me a taste for the Sciences.

This artwork is my best attempt at representing the feeling of loss we're all feeling. Me, my family, and his daughter.

I pledge to donate any proceeds made from this artwork to a charity supporting musicians in need, and present proof of this in whatever way I can (either a tx id if there's a music charity that accepts crypto, or by donating the equivalent of the crypto's current value to the charity directly if I can't find a music charity that accepts ETH/BTC).
